description: Source code for ADXL367 accelerometer driver in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, data acquisition, self-test, and setup functions.

methods.name: adxl367_setup_activity_detection
methods.description: Configures activity detection thresholds and enable/disable.

methods.name: adxl367_setup_inactivity_detection
methods.description: Configures inactivity detection thresholds and enable/disable.

methods.name: adxl367_set_op_mode
methods.description: Sets the device's operational mode (standby or measure).

methods.name: adxl367_set_low_noise
methods.description: Enables or disables low noise mode.

methods.name: adxl367_set_act_proc_mode
methods.description: Sets activity processing mode (linked or looped).

methods.name: adxl367_set_output_rate
methods.description: Sets the output data rate of the device.

methods.name: adxl367_set_fifo_sample_sets_nb
methods.description: Sets number of FIFO sample sets.

methods.name: adxl367_fifo_setup
methods.description: Configures FIFO with mode, format, read mode, and sample sets.

methods.name: adxl367_reset
methods.description: Performs software reset of the device.

methods.name: adxl367_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like frequency and thresholds.

methods.name: adxl367_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor values.

methods.name: adxl367_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor values.
